posts.cooked:
Hey other M:tG players -

Since we were talking about it in this thread, I got the idea to convert some of our favorite Sentinels into Magic cards.

Here's a link to the album:  https://imgur.com/a/yMf5u  I tried to make them strong and playable without being too apparently broken while capturing the essence of the different hero decks - hope y'all enjoy!
